title: Norse Atlantic's Critical Condition, the Army's Return to DC Airspace, and Boeing Beats Airbus in Malaysia
summary: A low-cost long-haul airline that never learned from Norwegian's collapse is now begging for a lifeline, the Army wants back in DC airspace less than two years after the deadliest US air disaster in decades, and Malaysia Airlines just handed Boeing a win over Airbus. Plus, two airlines are quietly trimming their route maps and the ICE jet bridge fallout keeps growing.
